answer: For a poll on a velvet cover for a crystal fable collection, the server rejects ballots not naming a listed option, then randomly pairs the rest. Matching pairs count as one vote; mismatched pairs count as two, and an unpaired ballot is discarded. In a pool of 100 ballots all favoring one option, 50 votes count, requiring two submissions each. Automation makes submissions cheap, and honest matching votes also lose weight.
